description: A set with an unknown converted to a list of numbers is an unknown list of the set's element type
notes: The spec converts each set element to the list's element type, so the result of a conversion to a list of numbers is a list of numbers, here an unknown one because the set's length isn't known. hashicorp/hcl gives an unknown list of strings, the set's own element type: conversionCollectionToList in go-cty's cty/convert/conversion_collection.go returns cty.UnknownVal(cty.List(val.Type().ElementType())) for a collection of unknown length, without converting to the target element type.
